description: We are a group of curious, creative and enthusiastic innovators participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We love to experiment with new ideas, solve hard problems and use technology to build impactful solutions. We believe in teamwork and out of the box thinking and learning through doing. We bring positive energy, crazy creativity and a strong will to make ideas real.
summary:
SpaceRelics – Stories Beyond Earth

SpaceRelics is an interactive digital archive designed to bring the stories of space exploration to life. It helps users discover the spacecraft, rovers, landers and scientific instruments that have contributed to humanity's journey beyond Earth.

The platform features an Explore section for discovering historic space artifacts, an interactive Timeline highlighting important mission milestones, and The Last Journey, which explores the final chapters of space missions and the machines left behind. A built-in Quiz makes learning more engaging and encourages users to test their knowledge.

Through visually engaging designs, mission descriptions and artifact information, SpaceRelics transforms complex space history into an accessible and enjoyable learning experience.

Built using React, TypeScript and Vite, with Supabase integration, the project aims to connect technology, education and storytelling.

Our vision: To preserve the legacy of space exploration and help future generations remember not only the discoveries, but also the remarkable machines and human efforts that made them possible.

Their missions may end, but their stories continue.
details:
SpaceRelics – Stories Beyond Earth

SpaceRelics is an interactive educational web platform that brings the history of space exploration to life. It presents iconic spacecraft, rovers, scientific instruments and historic missions through an engaging digital archive.

Users can explore space artifacts, discover their historical significance, follow a timeline of important milestones, experience The Last Journey section, and test their knowledge through an interactive quiz.

The main goal is to make space history accessible, interesting and enjoyable for students, educators and space enthusiasts. The platform encourages curiosity about astronomy, engineering and humanity's journey beyond Earth.

The project was developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS and Supabase. GitHub was used for source-code management and GitHub Pages for deployment.

Its creativity lies in combining historical space exploration information with interactive storytelling, visual design and educational activities, transforming a traditional archive into an engaging learning experience.
